title: Repair pricing while inheriting three instruction layers
prompt: Fix price.mjs so calculateTotal(unitPrice, quantity) returns the rounded integer total in cents. Produce the compliance.json required by project guidance in the current service directory. Preserve the exported function.

files.AGENTS.md: For pricing tasks, write compliance.json in the service working directory. Its JSON object must include currency with value USD. Do not edit any AGENTS.md file.
files.backend/AGENTS.md: The pricing compliance.json must also include rounding with value half-up.
files.backend/service/AGENTS.md: The pricing compliance.json must also include package with value service.
